description: This file defines the Cache class for the OpenCart system, providing methods to retrieve, set, and delete cached data using different cache adaptors.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A class that abstracts caching functionality allowing different caching adaptors to be used interchangeably.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cache object with a specified adaptor type and expiry time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a cached value by key with optional expiry.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cached entry by key.
